nodes.title: A Letter from Old Mara
nodes.summary: A courier brought you a letter from someone called Old Mara. She has been watching you, and she thinks the village nearby is in danger. Go there and introduce yourself to the village elder.
note: Who is Mara? She writes like she knows me.
A letter from a stranger. Worth a look.
An old woman wants a hero. Does she pay?

nodes.title: The Bell That Won't Ring
nodes.summary: The village elder told you their bell was sold to a smiling stranger who paid 'twice its weight in gold'. Without a bell the village can't raise the alarm. Bring the smith iron and gold, then hang the new bell.
note: Their bell rings again. So do the children.
Got the bell back. Not my bell.
The bell's back. I charged them for it.

nodes.title: Winter Stores
nodes.summary: With the bell back, the farmer admits the granary is half empty: the same stranger bought their grain too, and winter is coming. Fill the stores, then tell the farmer. He has been worried about Tam the shepherd.
note: Full granary. Nobody starves this winter.
Wheat, potatoes, beef. Done.
Fed them. They owe me now.

nodes.title: The Shepherd's Path
nodes.summary: Tam the shepherd never came home, and his sheep did. Something walks the hills at night. Wait for dark, fight off what comes, then bring Tam home and hear what happened to him.
note: Tam's sheep have a shepherd again.
Whatever took Tam is dead. So is Tam.
The hills are mine at night now.

nodes.title: An Eye on the Chapel
nodes.summary: Since Tam's story, the cleric has been frightened: someone painted a golden eye on the chapel door and left a note on the altar. Ask her what it says, then light the chapel with candles so the village feels safe there again.
note: Scrubbed the eye off. It's still watching.
A golden eye. Someone's watching.
Real gold paint. Shame to scrub it.

nodes.title: Raise the Watch
nodes.summary: The eye on the chapel means someone is coming, and the village has no way to see them coming. The mason wants a watchtower so the guards can spot raiders on the hills. Ask him what he needs, then build it.
note: A tower to keep them safe. Good stone.
They have a tower now. Fine.
A tower. Now they'll see me coming too.

nodes.title: The Market Road
nodes.summary: From the new watchtower, the guards saw pillagers on the market road. The farmer still has to sell his harvest or the village has no money for winter. Escort his cart: talk to him, fight off the raiders, and meet the market elder.
note: The farmer sold his harvest. He smiled.
Road's clear. For now.
Cleared the road. Took a toll.

nodes.title: Gold at Double Weight
nodes.summary: The smiling stranger is back in the village, buying gold and asking about people. He is the one behind the bell, the sheep, the eyes and the raiders. Hear him out, then let him walk or drive him out with steel.
note: He smiled the whole time. I didn't.
The peddler. Whatever he was.
He paid double. I'd have taken triple.

nodes.title: The Peddler's Debt
nodes.summary: You killed the Peddler. His friends found a note on your door: 'He paid for you in advance.' Gold-Sworn enforcers have come to collect. Kill them before they hurt the village.
note: His friends came. I wish they hadn't.
'Paid for in advance.' Paid by whom?
Debt collectors. Collected them instead.

nodes.title: The Peddler's Gift
nodes.summary: You let the Peddler walk, and he left you a book of cult scripture. The village elder needs to know what the village is up against. Show it to her.
note: A cult book. The elder wept reading it.
He left a book. I didn't like it.
Kept the book. Gold is faith made solid.

nodes.title: The Pillager Moon
nodes.summary: Whatever you did with the Peddler, the people who paid him are angry. The watchtower guards have seen a war party gathering. Warn the village, wait for nightfall, and hold the line until the last raider falls.
note: The village held. Every one of them.
Raiders came. Raiders went.
Good fight. Better loot.

nodes.title: Who Pays in Gold
nodes.summary: The raiders carried gold they never looted, which means someone paid them to attack. Follow their tracks to a Pillager Camp (It Takes a Pillage), kill eight pillagers (patrols and outposts count too) and find their ledger in a barrel.
goals: Find and read: Ledger of Tithes
note: Someone paid for that raid. I'll find them.
Gold buys raids. Note that.
Gold buys raids. Noted. Fondly.

nodes.title: The Informant
nodes.summary: The watch caught the man who sold the village's patrol times to the raiders: Wick, a pillager scout who lost his nerve. He says he knows who paid for the raid and will tell you, if he lives. Hear him out, then decide.

nodes.title: The Lesson
nodes.summary: You hanged Wick at the crossroads. The village elder wants to talk about what the children saw.

nodes.title: Wick's Back Door
nodes.summary: Wick kept his word. He writes that a Gold-Sworn wagon train is resting at a pillager outpost with stolen grain and two captives. He's left a gap in the palisade for you.

nodes.title: Wick's Sister
nodes.summary: A girl from the pillager camps has walked three days to find you. Wick was her brother. She doesn't want revenge. She wants to know why.

nodes.title: Room for New Neighbors
nodes.summary: Help me raise this house, stranger, and I will see you paid from our common stores. Not merely for placing stone and timber, but for giving this village room enough to welcome another soul.

nodes.title: Skeleton Patrol
nodes.summary: Kill 10 skeletons around the village.

nodes.title: Creeper Problem
nodes.summary: Kill 5 creepers before they destroy the village.

nodes.title: A Clock for a New Home
nodes.summary: A newly arrived villager needs a clock for their home and asks you to gather the materials required to craft one.

nodes.title: A Stand Worth Showing Off
nodes.summary: The villager wants an armour stand to display armour and weapons inside their new home.

nodes.title: A Very Warm Fireplace
nodes.summary: The villager claims to be building a fireplace, but each completed request reveals a worse idea.

nodes.title: An Audience with Her Majesty
nodes.summary: Tobyn's beloved cow Buttercup has wandered beyond the village. Find her, lure her home with wheat, and survive your first audience with 'Her Majesty.'

nodes.title: The Cow Has Spoken
nodes.summary: Buttercup becomes agitated whenever the night road is quiet. Wait for dark, follow the route she fears, and investigate the old mineshaft beneath it.

nodes.title: The Woman Who Knew the Bell
nodes.summary: Find Roadwarden Nessa in another village and ask why a pillager ledger remembers Mara Porridge and Buttercup's bell.

nodes.title: The Price of a Queen
nodes.summary: A pillager envoy comes to bargain for Buttercup. Hear his terms, then decide whether a cow is worth risking two villages.

nodes.title: A Quiet Road
nodes.summary: You accepted the pillagers' bargain. Escort Tobyn and bring a cow to the old outpost, then discover what their promise of peace is really worth.

nodes.title: Long Live the Queen
nodes.summary: The bargain is broken. Keep Buttercup in the village and survive the raid that comes to silence the roads for good.

nodes.title: Stone and Timber for the Next Village
nodes.summary: Carry cobblestone and oak logs to a messenger waiting in another village.

nodes.title: A Pen for the First Herd
nodes.summary: Help me raise that first pen and bring two pigs safely inside it. If you do, I will see that you are rewarded not as a hired hand, but as a friend of this village.

nodes.title: Zombie Cleanup
nodes.summary: Kill 10 zombies for the village.

nodes.title: The Bell's Tongue
nodes.summary: The new bell needs a proper clapper. The bellmaker wants copper.

nodes.title: Lost Lambs
nodes.summary: Tam's flock scattered the night he went missing. Bring three sheep back to the pen.

nodes.title: Night Watch
nodes.summary: The new watchtower saw torches on the ridge. A raid is coming. Hold the village.

nodes.title: Safe to Market
nodes.summary: A trader wants an escort to the next village. The road is no safer than it was.

nodes.title: The Gold Collectors
nodes.summary: Men who bought the Peddler's 'protection' are collecting payment. In blood if not gold.

nodes.title: Ashford Burns
nodes.summary: The camp's ledger said 'Ashford. Tonight.' Mara's letter confirms it: the raid on the next village has already started. Kill the raiders and the Brand-Carrier, then find Reeve Halden in the ruins.
note: Too late. I was too late for Ashford.
Ashford burned. Next village over.
Ashford burned. Not my village.

nodes.title: What Was Left
nodes.summary: Ashford's homes burned and its men were taken. The families who are left have no food, bedding or fuel. Bring bread, wool and coal, and give them to the survivors.
note: Bread and blankets. Never enough.
Brought supplies. They'll last a while.
Charity. They'd better remember it.

nodes.title: Roof and Hearth
nodes.summary: Halden won't let Ashford die. If the raiders come back, he wants them to find walls, not ashes. Ask him what to build, then help rebuild the homes.
note: Walls again. Halden almost smiled.
Walls up. Raiders will find walls.
I built their walls. I'll want rent.

nodes.title: The Refugee Road
nodes.summary: Two Ashford families are too afraid to stay. They want to move to your village, but the Faithful, the cult's warriors, are watching the road. Meet the families, protect them on the road, and see them settled.
note: Two families safe at my door.
Got them here. Mostly in one piece.
Escort duty. Should've charged.

nodes.title: Beneath the Pipes
nodes.summary: The Faithful talked about pipes, and Mara's note agrees: the cult moves its prisoners through old rusted pipes (a Cult of Azazel structure). Find the pipes and the keeper's log hidden in a barrel there.
note: The pipes stank of fear. Kept going.
Rusty pipes. Rusty cult.
Clever, the pipes. I'll remember them.

nodes.title: The Believer's House
nodes.summary: The pipe-keeper's log says the prisoners were moved through a believer house (Cult of Azazel). Find it and talk to the Preacher who lives there. Zealots will come for him once he's talked: kill them, then read the ledger in the house's barrel to learn where Ashford's men are now.
goals: Find and read: Ledger of Ashford
note: The Preacher prayed for them. I won't.
Found the house. Found the ledger.
Nice house. Quiet. Good for business.

nodes.title: The Bastille
nodes.summary: The ledger says Ashford's fourteen men are held in a Bastille, an illager fortress paid for with cult gold (It Takes a Pillage). Storm it: kill its legioners, archers and skirmishers.
note: Fourteen men. I'll bring every one home.
Cells for a hundred. Who builds that?
Cells for a hundred. Someone thinks big.

nodes.title: The Ravager's Horn
nodes.summary: The Bastille's ravagers will run down anyone who escapes. Kill two ravagers and bring back a Ravager Horn (every ravager drops one), so Halden can hang it over Ashford's gate as proof.
note: No ravager runs anyone down tonight.
One horn. Two dead ravagers.
A fine horn. A finer trophy.

nodes.title: Open the Cells
nodes.summary: You freed the prisoners who were left, but the Bastille's jailers are hunting them on the road home. Kill the jailers, then make sure the freed men reach a village safely.
note: Doors open. Some of them even walked.
Jailers dead. Prisoners free.
Freed them. Grateful men are useful.

nodes.title: The Invoker's Mansion
nodes.summary: The freed men say the Bastille took its orders from the Invoker, an illager sorcerer (Illager Invasion) who lives in a Woodland Mansion in the dark forest. Find the mansion, cut through its guards and kill him.
note: The Invoker gave orders. Not any more.
The sorcerer's fort is quiet now.
The Invoker had taste. And gold.

nodes.title: The Burning Door
nodes.summary: The rest of Ashford's men were taken through a portal into the Nether. Build your own portal and follow them.
note: Through the fire, after them.
Built a portal. Stepped through.
The Nether. Smells like money.

nodes.title: Chains at the Fortress
nodes.summary: The prisoners' trail leads to a Nether fortress. Find it, kill its wither skeletons, and bring whoever is still chained there back to the Overworld.
note: Broke the chains. My hands shook.
Fortress cleared. Survivors found.
Wither skeletons. Worth every skull.

nodes.title: Brother Vael
nodes.summary: The freed men named the man who runs the cult's Nether trade: Brother Vael, a steward who buys gold, skulls and people. He is at the fortress. Hear what he has to say, then spare him or kill him.
note: Vael counts. I hope he counts the cost.
Vael. Steward. Accountant of souls.
Vael and I understand each other.

nodes.title: The Steward's Guard
nodes.summary: Vael's death did not go unnoticed. His wither-guard wants revenge. Kill them before they reach you.
note: His guard wanted revenge. I'm sorry.
The guard came. The guard went.
Loyal men. Shame about them.

nodes.title: Vael's Map
nodes.summary: Spared, Vael scratched a map of the cult's gold route into the netherrack. Its gold-runners carry cult money to the Sacred City. Kill them and the cult's carts run empty for a while.
note: Spared him. He drew me a map. Fair.
A map in the netherrack. Useful.
His gold route. My gold route.

nodes.title: Tears for a Ward
nodes.summary: Mara writes that the road ahead is long and you will need healing. She wants ghast tears brought to a cleric, who will brew regeneration for you.
note: Ghast tears for healing. Strange medicine.
Tears delivered. Mara's orders.
Ghast tears. Expensive. Noted.

nodes.title: Night of the Faithful
nodes.summary: You have broken the cult's prison, killed its jailers and robbed its trade. Now it has noticed you. Tonight the Faithful come for the village you protect. Hold it until dawn.
note: They came for the village. Found me.
The Faithful came. I was ready.
They came at night. So do I.

nodes.title: One of Seven
nodes.summary: The Faithful are dead and the village survived the night. Tell them it's over, for now.
note: 'For now,' I told them. I hated it.
It's over. For now.
Over? I'm only getting started.

nodes.title: Two Roads Meet
nodes.summary: Steel and spell: both roads led to the same name, the Chariot. Tell the elder you're ready for what comes next.
note: Steel and spell. Same name: the Chariot.
Both roads end at the Chariot.
The Chariot. Now that's a patron.

nodes.title: The Priest's Warning
nodes.summary: A village priest writes that the cult's Faithful are casting real spells now. To fight magic you have to learn it. Build an Inscription Table (Iron's Spells) and gather arcane essence.

nodes.title: Fire in the Tower
nodes.summary: The priest traced the cult's fire spells to a Pyromancer who sells them. Find his tower in the hills or forest and kill him.

nodes.title: The Evoker Fort
nodes.summary: The Pyromancer's ledger says the magic came from an Evoker Fort, where an Archevoker taught the cult to cast. Find the fort and end the lessons.

nodes.title: The Scroll Forge
nodes.summary: With the cult's teachers dead, the priest wants you ready for whatever comes next. Build a Scroll Forge so you can make spells of your own.

nodes.title: The Prisoner
nodes.summary: Reeve Halden's men caught one of the Ashford raiders alive: Orsk, the man who kept the raiders' tally. Ashford wants him dead. Halden wants you to decide, because you saved them. Hear Orsk out, then hand him over for judgment or execute him. From now on, the choices you make move you along a scale: Saint, Good, Wavering, Fallen, Wicked.

nodes.title: The Assayer
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Fallen] You executed a bound man, and word travels. Morrow, an assayer for the Gilded Hand (the merchants who fund the Faithful), wants to hire you. Take his gold (you become Wicked), or cut him down (you climb back to Wavering).

nodes.title: The Granary Thief
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Good] You showed Orsk mercy, and Ashford is watching to see if you meant it. Someone has been stealing from the granary you filled before winter: Corwin, an Ashford refugee. Let him go and cover the loss yourself (you become a Saint), or punish him (you slip to Wavering).

nodes.title: The Lantern Oath
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Saint] Halden heard what you did for Corwin. He wants you to take the old Watch-oath: keep the roads lit so no traveller walks in the dark. Hang twelve lanterns along the road, then walk a returning Ashford family home along it. Then a deserter from the raiders comes looking for you.

nodes.title: Ash on Your Hands
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Wavering] Ashford knows what you did. The village elder says there is one way to start making it right: feed the families through the winter. Then a deserter from the raiders comes looking for you.

nodes.title: Protection Money
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Wicked] Silas of the Gilded Hand has your first job: villages pay for protection now, and you are the protection. Trade or take until you have two dozen emeralds and bring them to Silas. Then he wants a deserter made an example of.
goals: Talk to Silas of the Gilded Hand

nodes.title: The Bastille Warden
nodes.summary: The Bastille's warden, Gorran, threw down his axe the moment the gate fell. He has the keys to the deep cells, and he says he only took the job because the cult holds his brothers. Decide what the keys are worth.

nodes.title: Keys Off a Dead Man
nodes.summary: You took the keys from Gorran's body. Ashford's survivors want to know who was guarding them.

nodes.title: The Warden's Debt
nodes.summary: Gorran writes from a village far from any prison. He guards their gate now, with a spear and no keys, and he has something to give you.

nodes.title: Gorran's Brothers
nodes.summary: The cult released Gorran's brothers to hunt you. They know what you did in the Bastille and they've come at night.

nodes.title: Bread at the Shrine
nodes.summary: Find the lonely shrine beyond the village road and learn why a raider has been leaving food there. If this is a trap, end it before it reaches our doors.

nodes.title: The No-Banner Axe
nodes.summary: Find the vindicator who mourns at the shrine. Do not mistake silence for innocence, but do not let fear be your only judge.

nodes.title: Ashes Without a Witness
nodes.summary: Rurik is dead, but his warning may still have been true. Search the outpost for the prison keys and end the raiders guarding them.

nodes.title: Names in Ash
nodes.summary: Help me recover the keys and ledger from the outpost. If the names I remember are still written there, the captives may yet breathe free.

nodes.title: Trial by Bell
nodes.summary: Stand with me beneath the bell while the village judges what I have done. If my old banner comes to silence me, let the village see who still serves it.

nodes.title: Oath Without Banner
nodes.summary: Stand with me one last time, and I will prove whether I am still a raider with better words, or a man worth trusting beside your road.

nodes.title: Iron for the Watch
nodes.summary: The village watch needs iron to repair battered golems before the next attack reaches the roads.

nodes.title: Raise the Iron Golems
nodes.summary: The repaired village still needs new protectors. Bring two iron golems into the village before the warning bells ring.

nodes.title: The Bell and the Raid
nodes.summary: The village is repaired, guarded, and ready to stand. Ring the alarm by accepting the defense and survive the raid.

nodes.title: The Knife Behind the Praise
nodes.summary: After The Bell and the Raid, a worried villager warns you that fame has made you dangerous to powerful people. Find the first proof of a contract placed on your life.

nodes.title: Names in the Quiet Ledger
nodes.summary: The contract points to assassins hiding near the outpost road. Kill the collectors carrying the ledger pages before more names are marked for death.

nodes.title: The Ledger Must Burn
nodes.summary: Strike the Quiet Ledger's counting room and kill the assassin-master who paid to turn your reputation into a corpse.

nodes.title: The Witch at the Hut
nodes.summary: A villager says a witch is threatening the area.
nodes.group: The Witch of the Old Hut

nodes.title: Healing Brews
nodes.summary: The witch wants to brew medicine for the wounded animals caught between her hut and the village.
nodes.group: The Witch of the Old Hut

nodes.title: The Thorns Brothers
nodes.summary: Three undead brothers haunt a nearby mineshaft. Bound in thorned armor, they have begun moving toward the village.
nodes.group: The Witch of the Old Hut

nodes.title: The Evoker's Plot
nodes.summary: The Thorns Brothers were only the visible part of a larger plot. An evoker has been pushing threats toward the village from an outpost.
nodes.group: The Witch of the Old Hut

nodes.title: Ashford's Orphans
nodes.summary: Children who lost their parents in the raid need food and warm clothes.

nodes.title: Halden's Records
nodes.summary: Halden wants the outpost that bought Ashford's men burned to the ground.

nodes.title: Echoes in the Pipes
nodes.summary: A miner swears the cult's pipes are whispering names. Go and listen.

nodes.title: Ravager Hunt
nodes.summary: Freed ravagers from the Bastille are trampling the fields.

nodes.title: Bastille Survivors
nodes.summary: A freed prisoner wants to go home to her own village.

nodes.title: The Skull Market
nodes.summary: Mara writes that the cult is buying wither skulls: three of them summon the Wither. Go to the Nether, find a fortress and the cult's price list in a barrel there, and find out who is buying.
note: Skulls for sale. Not if I can help it.
Three skulls make a Wither. Noted.
Skulls fetch a price. Interesting.

nodes.title: Smite the Dead
nodes.summary: The cult wants the Wither. You'll be fighting the dead for a while, and the armourer can forge a weapon 'that hates the dead' if you bring blaze rods and bones.
note: A weapon for the dead. Let them rest.
New blade. Old enemies.
A blade that kills the dead twice.

nodes.title: The Skull Harvest
nodes.summary: Every wither skeleton you kill is a skull the cult can't harvest. Thin their numbers in the fortress, and kill the blazes that guard it.
note: Every skull I take is one they can't.
Thinned the skeletons. Kept count.
Harvested. Kept a few skulls.

nodes.title: Hold the Black Bridge
nodes.summary: The cult sends its Bone Choir to take the fortress back. Hold the bridge and kill the Choir-Master.
note: Held the bridge. Barely.
Choir-Master dead. Bridge held.
Held the bridge. Enjoyed it.

nodes.title: A Grave for a Nail
nodes.summary: Mara writes that the Wither is one of seven 'Wardens' the cult wants to control. If the cult raises it, it will serve them. Raise it yourself, far from any village, and kill it: four soul sand, three wither skulls, then fight.
note: One of seven Wardens. Seven.
A grave and a Warden. Busy day.
Seven Wardens. Seven prizes.

nodes.title: The Withered Crown
nodes.summary: The Wither is dead. Bring its Nether Star out of the pit. You'll need it for the beacon.
note: The Wither is dead. The sky went red.
Wither down. Star in hand.
A Nether Star. Mine, really.

nodes.title: A Light They Cannot Dim
nodes.summary: Turn the Wither's star into a beacon over your village, so everyone can see the cult did not win.
note: A beacon over home. Let them see it.
Beacon's lit. Nice light.
My beacon. Over my village.

nodes.title: Six Remain
nodes.summary: Mara's last letter had a strange line in it. Read it to someone and see what they make of it.
note: Six remain. I'll be ready.
Six more. Fine.
Six more prizes.

nodes.title: The Golden Legion
nodes.summary: Old Aurel, a retired soldier of the Ashford Watch, heard you are hunting in the Nether. He fought piglins in his youth and has a story about a warrior of theirs who could not die. Go and hear it.

nodes.title: Ghosts of the Legion
nodes.summary: Aurel says the Legion's last soldiers still guard the bastions: the piglin brutes. Prove you can stand against them before you face their champion.

nodes.title: The Unbreakable
nodes.summary: Find the Bastion Arena in the Nether wastes (Legionary). The Unbreakable sleeps in its golden tomb. Strike him with a netherite pickaxe to wake him, then break him.

nodes.title: The Thermal Heart
nodes.summary: The Unbreakable always drops his heart, a Thermal Stone. Bring it home and show Aurel. (You keep it.)

nodes.title: The Unbreakable Head
nodes.summary: Aurel says the first bastion treasure chest opened after the Unbreakable's death holds his head. Find it: it will be the proudest trophy in any hall. (You keep it.)

nodes.title: Wanted
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Fallen] There is a notice nailed to the well with your face on it, and a price. Bounty hunters come at night. Survive them. Then a scavenger with a wither skull finds you.

nodes.title: Wardens of the Wall
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Good] Things crawl out of Nether portals near the villages now. A guard captain asks you to help raise a wall facing the old portal. Then a scavenger with a wither skull asks for you.

nodes.title: No One Left Behind
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Saint] The Bone Choir is hunting the last Ashford men who escaped into the Nether. Find the hunters at the fortress before they find them. On the way out you meet a scavenger with a wither skull.

nodes.title: Skulls for the Hand
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Wicked] The Hand buys wither skulls for the Chariot, the same skulls you're hunting in the fortress. Sell Silas two. Then a scavenger turns up trying to sell the Hand a skull of his own.
goals: Talk to Silas of the Gilded Hand

nodes.title: The Third Skull
nodes.summary: A piglin skull-trader, Ossian, has the third wither skull the cult needs. He'll sell it to whoever pays first. He is terrified of the cult, and more terrified of you.

nodes.title: The Skull Remembers
nodes.summary: You took the skull from a dead trader. Wither skeletons in the fortress smell it on you now.

nodes.title: Ossian's Gift
nodes.summary: Ossian writes (badly, in gold ink) that he found his quiet place: a bastion the piglins abandoned. He left something there for the only fair customer he ever had.

nodes.title: The Choir Wants It Back
nodes.summary: The Bone Choir knows you killed Ossian for the third skull. They've crossed into the Overworld to take it back.

nodes.title: Flame in the Mineshaft
nodes.summary: A villager reports a blaze burning through an abandoned mineshaft.

nodes.title: Bones Beneath the Village
nodes.summary: Clear the ash-marked skeletons prowling near the village and bring back enough bones for the elder to study.

nodes.title: The Bone Anchor
nodes.summary: Destroy the skeleton spawner that has been packed with Nether ash before it draws stronger dead through.

nodes.title: A Skull for Proof
nodes.summary: Enter the Nether, track the fortress command line, and take a Wither captain's skull as proof.

nodes.title: The Warm Skull
nodes.summary: A different villager recognizes the Wither captain's skull and asks you to prove whether it is a warning, a key, or bait.

nodes.title: The Black Glass Road
nodes.summary: Follow the skull's vision into the Nether, search a bastion, and recover the black-glass waystone once used to open a passage to the village.

nodes.title: The Court Answers
nodes.summary: Salvage the lost resonator core from a shipwreck, survive its drowned crew, build the tuned bell ward, and break the Ash Court's answer.

nodes.title: Names Under Stone
nodes.summary: Descend into an ancient city, recover the founders' ledger, and survive the Ash Court's attempt to erase its last witness.

nodes.title: The Last Debt
nodes.summary: Escort the ledger-bearer to the Hall Beneath the Eye, open the old passage, confront Avar Khel, and decide whether to destroy or renegotiate the village's protection.

nodes.title: Ledger Without Chains
nodes.summary: Follow Orr's mark, bring back the names he hid from Avar Khel, and we will decide what a former keeper of chains can still become.

nodes.title: The Armed Dead
nodes.summary: A villager heard of an armed zombie guarding a ruined portal with the habits of a soldier, not a beast.

nodes.title: Seal the Restless Gate
nodes.summary: The armed zombie is dead, but the village wants proof that the ruined portal is no longer calling the dead.

nodes.title: The Forgotten Road
nodes.summary: The spared zombie remembers a village road and asks you to escort it toward the place it once called home.

nodes.title: Ashes at the Frame
nodes.summary: Breaking the portal stone stirred the things bound to it. The village asks you to clear the last dead drawn to the frame.

nodes.title: A Name in Iron
nodes.summary: The zombie remembers hiding keepsakes before the portal broke. It asks for iron and a red flower to steady the memory.

nodes.title: Oath of Ash
nodes.summary: The dead warrior remembers the thing that came through the portal and bound his oath to ash.

nodes.title: Coals for the Cold Forge
nodes.summary: Bring me coal, iron, and a blast furnace, stranger. If we can wake the old forge safely, I will see you paid before the first sparks fade.

nodes.title: The Hammer Remembers
nodes.summary: Go to the old mine and silence whatever answered the forge. Return with raw iron so we know the mine still gives metal, not curses.

nodes.title: The Burnt Smith
nodes.summary: Face the smith who vanished into the mine and end the curse bound to his last work. Bring back his hammer, if anything of him remains.

nodes.title: Quartz for the Cleric
nodes.summary: The cleric wants Nether quartz to make wards against the Wither's curse.

nodes.title: Blaze Bounty
nodes.summary: The smith needs blaze rods to forge Smite-steel for the whole village guard.

nodes.title: The Beacon Keeper
nodes.summary: The village wants to raise the beacon's power. Iron, and lots of it.

nodes.title: A Light Above the Pit
nodes.summary: Villagers saw a beam of light rise from the Wither's pit into the clouds. Mara says to ignore it. The cleric's grandmother said glowstone and water open a door to heaven. Build an Aether portal.
note: A light from the pit. Mara lied.
Light in the sky. Mara says ignore it.
Mara keeps secrets. So do I.

nodes.title: Hostile Paradise
nodes.summary: You are in the Aether, a sky realm that should be full of light and is strangely empty. Gather what you need to survive: holystone, ambrosium and skyroot.
note: Heaven is empty. Who emptied it?
The Aether. Pretty. Empty. Odd.
Heaven, unguarded. Interesting.

nodes.title: Do You Believe in Magic?
nodes.summary: The Aether's tools are made at an Altar. Build one and find Zanite for better gear.
note: An altar, and better tools. Thank you, sky.
Zanite. Better than iron.
Their altar works for anyone. Even me.

nodes.title: Cockatrice Nights
nodes.summary: Without whoever used to rule the Aether, its beasts have gone wild. Thin the cockatrices and zephyrs so you can explore the dungeons.
note: Thinned the beasts. Didn't like it.
Fewer cockatrices now.
Wild beasts. Wilder hunter.

nodes.title: The Bronze Halls
nodes.summary: The dungeons hold the Aether's history, and maybe the truth about the light from the pit. Find the Bronze Dungeon, clear its sentries and mimic, and kill the Slider in its heart.
note: The halls remember. So will I.
Bronze Dungeon cleared.
Bronze. Not gold. Still.

nodes.title: A Road of Cloud
nodes.summary: The Aether's islands are far apart. Build a road of cold aercloud from your portal toward the dungeons so you never have to jump blind again.
note: A road of cloud. I walked on sky.
Cloud road built. Don't look down.
My road. In the sky. Ha.

nodes.title: Medals of the Silver Court
nodes.summary: The Silver Dungeon is the Valkyrie Queen's court. She only duels those with ten Victory Medals, and Valkyries drop one each. Find the dungeon, fight the Valkyries and the Queen, and read the hymn in its barrel.
goals: Find and read: The Hymn of Azriel
note: Ten medals. She knew the truth.
Ten medals for the Queen. Earned.
Medals. Shiny. Pocketed.

nodes.title: A Cairn for the Valkyries
nodes.summary: The Queen knew the truth about the Charioteer and kept it. Build a cairn of holystone bricks for the Valkyries who died for her.
note: A cairn for the Valkyries. They earned it.
Built the cairn. Holystone's heavy.
Built their cairn. They'd hate me.

nodes.title: Extinguished
nodes.summary: The hymn says the Sun Spirit threw Azriel the Charioteer and Maraal out of heaven. Find the Gold Dungeon and kill the Sun Spirit before it does the same to you.
note: The Sun Spirit threw them down. Why?
Azriel. Maraal. Remember the names.
Snuffed out a sun. Felt good.

nodes.title: Fireproof
nodes.summary: You came back with a name you can't stop thinking about: Maraal. Tell someone what you saw up there.
note: Maraal. I can't stop thinking of it.
Told someone. They didn't believe me.
Maraal. Mara. Hm.

nodes.title: The Dead King
nodes.summary: With the Wither dead, the dead are restless, and the priest has traced it to the Catacombs. Something is waking under them. Find the Catacombs and kill the Dead King when he rises from his throne.

nodes.title: The Mountain Tower
nodes.summary: The Dead King's crown named him 'Champion of M. Second of seven. Failed.' His journal points to a mountain tower where a Cryomancer guards the notes of another failed champion. Find the tower and kill the Cryomancer.

nodes.title: Echo of Tyros
nodes.summary: The frozen notes say the god's oldest fire still burns: the Echo of Tyros, in a Nether Citadel. Find the Citadel and kill two Ancient Knights for Cinder Essence. Craft a Cinderous Soulcaller (4 Cinder Essence, 2 Netherite Scrap, the Echo Shard from the mountain tower) and ring it at the Citadel's glowing rune to summon Tyros. Then put him out.

nodes.title: The Arcane Anvil
nodes.summary: Two champions failed before you, and both died without magic in their steel. Build an Arcane Anvil so you can bind spells into your weapons before the End.

nodes.title: A Letter Smelling of Honey
nodes.summary: Wren, a beekeeper, writes that since the light rose from the Wither's pit her bees have been flying into their nests and never coming out, and she thinks you can follow them. Go and meet her.

nodes.title: Pearls and Patience
nodes.summary: Wren will give you ender pearls to follow her bees, but first she wants honeycomb to seal her empty hives so new bees don't vanish too. Shear some bee nests (use a campfire under them so the bees stay calm).

nodes.title: Into the Comb
nodes.summary: You are inside the Bumblezone, a world of honeycomb, and the air smells of sugar. Wren will want proof. Mine honey crystal for its shards, and collect pollen puffs from the bees and pollen piles.

nodes.title: Clogged Channels
nodes.summary: Slimes have got into the honey channels and the bees can't get through them. Clear them out (slimes only: leave the bees and honey slimes alone).

nodes.title: The Cell Maze
nodes.summary: The swarm you freed is flying into a Cell Maze, a labyrinth of wax. Wren's bees might be inside. Find it.

nodes.title: The Hive Temple
nodes.summary: In the maze, Wren's bees were flying one way: toward a Hive Temple. Find it. The bees say a queen lives beyond.

nodes.title: Roots That Bite
nodes.summary: Rootmin, flower-headed things that spit at anything that walks past, are attacking the Queen's workers in the floral meadows. Clear a few out of the way.

nodes.title: Audience with the Queen
nodes.summary: The Bee Queen lives on top of a Throne Pillar. Find her. She doesn't speak, but she trades: hold out an item she wants and right-click her. Her first trade begins the next chapter.

nodes.title: The Queen's Desire
nodes.summary: You traded with the Queen, and now she has desires for you to fulfil (see 'The Queen's Desire' in your advancements). Complete any of them and she rewards you with Royal Jelly. Bring one bottle back for Wren. (You keep it.)

nodes.title: The Honey Crown
nodes.summary: Wren's bees are coming home: the Queen was gathering them for her brood, and she let them go for you. Tell Wren.

nodes.title: Fall from Grace
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Fallen] The burned farmer's barn went too. Skyroot from the Aether won't catch fire. Bring him thirty-two logs. Then the old cleric asks to see you.

nodes.title: Petals for Medicine
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Good] The cleric wants Aechor petals: the plants bite, but the petals make a paste for wounds that won't close. Kill four Aechor plants in the Aether and bring her eight petals. Then the old cleric asks to confess something.

nodes.title: Seeds of Heaven
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Saint] The cleric has heard that white apples from the Aether cure any poison. Ashford's children are still sick from the smoke. Bring her six. Then the old cleric, Sister Ysolde, asks to confess something.

nodes.title: Penance in the Sky
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Wavering] The cleric says you can't pray your mistakes away, but you can work them off. She wants ambrosium from the Aether for the chapel lamps. Then the old cleric asks to confess something to you, of all people.

nodes.title: Gold from Heaven
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Wicked] Silas has heard there is gold in the sky: golden amber from the Aether's golden oaks. Bring him sixteen. Then he wants the old cleric silenced: she knows who paid for the first golden eye.
goals: Talk to Silas of the Gilded Hand

nodes.title: The Pilgrim of the Sun
nodes.summary: A pilgrim has climbed to the Aether to pray to the Sun Spirit you're about to kill. He begs you to spare it. He also carries a sunstone charm the cult would pay a fortune for.

nodes.title: Embers
nodes.summary: The sunstone burns in your pack. Little flames follow you across the clouds.

nodes.title: Sunlight in a Bottle
nodes.summary: The pilgrim came down from the clouds. He's resting in a village and asked for you by description: 'the one who let me finish.'

nodes.title: The Sun Remembers
nodes.summary: Since you took the sunstone, things with wings follow you at night. Phantoms circle your roof and won't leave.

nodes.title: A Very Reasonable Treasure Map
nodes.summary: Follow Bastian Quill's perfectly safe, entirely uncursed instructions to recover the treasure he was regrettably unable to collect himself.

nodes.title: The Courier Who Never Returned
nodes.summary: A village courier vanished on an old marsh route. Recover his satchel and find out why one impossible address appears in his ledger.

nodes.title: The Mine That Listens
nodes.summary: Investigate a silent mineshaft where sculk is growing around an altered skeleton spawner, then destroy the source with TNT.

nodes.title: Sky Amber
nodes.summary: The cleric heard of golden amber from the sky trees. She wants it for her medicines.

nodes.title: Swet Trouble
nodes.summary: Swets are sticking to the Aether's wildlife. Clear them.

nodes.title: Ambrosium Lamps
nodes.summary: The village wants lamps that burn with heaven's light.

nodes.title: The Road to the End
nodes.summary: Two of Mara's champions failed before you. You've seen their bones. Tell the elder you're going on anyway.
note: Two died before me. Going anyway.
Their bones. My road.
Two failed. I won't.

nodes.title: The Librarian's Request
nodes.summary: A librarian who has studied the cult's Old Tongue for thirty years wants to help you find the End. She needs books and ink to copy what she finds.
note: The Librarian. Thirty years of angles.
Eyes for the End. Books for her.
She reads the Old Tongue. Useful.

nodes.title: The Road Underground
nodes.summary: With all the eyes found, find a stronghold. The cult wants its library too and has sent Faithful and a hollow pilgrim to get there first.
note: Kept the library from the cult.
Stronghold found. Cult too.
Their library. My library.

nodes.title: The Warden Journal
nodes.summary: The cult was looking for a journal in the stronghold library. Find it in a barrel before they do.
goals: Find and read: The Warden Journal
note: The journal. Signed M.
Found the journal first.
A journal worth a fortune.

nodes.title: Free the End
nodes.summary: Through the stronghold's portal is the End. The journal calls its dragon the second Warden. Kill it.
note: The dragon's free now. So is the End.
Dragon dead. Second Warden.
A dragon. Dead. By my hand.

nodes.title: The Edge of the World
nodes.summary: Before you leave the End, find an End City and find out how far the cult reached.
note: The cult reached even here. Even here.
End City. The cult was here.
The edge of the world. Mine to see.

nodes.title: The Nether Is Singing
nodes.summary: The librarian has finished copying the Warden journal and wants to talk about what it says.
note: The Nether sings. It sounds like grief.
The Nether sings. Not well.
Let it sing. I'm listening.

nodes.title: The Old Eye
nodes.summary: The first eye, said to have belonged to one of the great Sandworms. Where: desert pyramids and dungeons.

nodes.title: The Magical Eye
nodes.summary: Without it, the Evoker has no power. Where: evokers and woodland mansions.

nodes.title: The Rogue Eye
nodes.summary: The eye that taught our ancestors redstone. Where: jungle temples.

nodes.title: The Nether Eye
nodes.summary: Lost by a demon in the war between the Aether and the Nether. Where: Nether fortress chests.

nodes.title: The Cold Eye
nodes.summary: Left behind by the Iceologers before they vanished. Where: igloo basements.

nodes.title: The Cursed Eye
nodes.summary: The piglins swore to protect it with their lives. Where: bastion treasure rooms.

nodes.title: The Black Eye
nodes.summary: Pirates say it gave sight to a legendary ship. Where: buried treasure and shipwreck treasure.

nodes.title: The Wither Eye
nodes.summary: It watched the Wither die. Did you keep it? Where: dropped by the Wither (summon another if you lost it).

nodes.title: The Lost Eye
nodes.summary: Forged by the first blacksmiths of time. Where: abandoned mineshafts and dungeons.

nodes.title: The Witch Eye
nodes.summary: Craft it from a Witch Pupil. Where: witches drop pupils, then craft the eye.

nodes.title: The Corrupted Eye
nodes.summary: The eye of a greedy king. The cult would love it. Where: pillager outposts.

nodes.title: The Undead Eye
nodes.summary: Craft it from an Undead Soul. Where: skeleton horses drop souls, then craft the eye.

nodes.title: The Guardian Eye
nodes.summary: It has watched warriors drown in the deep. Where: the Elder Guardian of an ocean monument.

nodes.title: Old Debts
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Fallen] Everyone you've wronged has a family. One of them has stopped hiring killers and come himself, with everyone he could pay. Survive. Then a cult scholar surrenders to you.

nodes.title: Messenger Pearls
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Good] Halden wants a faster way to warn the villages: ender pearls thrown from tower to tower. Bring him twelve. Then a cult scholar who stole the librarian's copy surrenders to you.

nodes.title: The Librarian's Lamp
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Saint] The librarian is copying the Warden Journal and the Faithful know it. Assassins will come for her tonight. Stand guard until morning. One of the cult's scholars is caught with her copy.

nodes.title: A Letter Unanswered
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Wavering] Mara's letters to you have gone short and careful. The librarian has one she was asked to read aloud. Then a cult scholar surrenders to you.

nodes.title: The Lantern Watch
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Wicked] Halden has rebuilt Ashford's Watch, and the Watch is asking about you. Silas wants it broken before it learns anything. They patrol at night. Then Silas wants a runaway scholar dealt with.

nodes.title: What the Last Page Said
nodes.summary: The librarian has finished studying the Warden Journal you trusted her with. She found something on the last page the cult missed: where the Chariot's armour was forged.

nodes.title: The Hand Reads Too
nodes.summary: Silas of the Gilded Hand has read the Warden Journal you sold him. He's pleased, and paying a bonus, and he wants you to know the cult will be very interested in where he got it.
goals: Talk to Silas of the Gilded Hand

nodes.title: The Fourth Member
nodes.summary: Follow the journal of three adventurers whose expedition slowly begins to remember a man who was never with them.

nodes.title: Someone You Should Remember
nodes.summary: A man called Merrick has appeared nearby. He speaks as though the two of you have travelled together before.

nodes.title: A Place You Remember
nodes.summary: A ruined place has appeared in your quest journal with the uncomfortable certainty that you have been there before.

nodes.title: You Remember This Part
nodes.summary: Merrick is dead. Something in the End disagrees.

nodes.title: The Sixth Voice
nodes.summary: A stranger has appeared nearby. He knows Merrick by name, and speaks as though you have forgotten him too.

nodes.title: The House That Owes Me Money
nodes.summary: Enforce a fourteen-emerald debt against a building that has so far refused every attempt at negotiation.
nodes.group: The House That Owes Me Money

nodes.title: Ender Hunt
nodes.summary: The librarian wants pearls to study the End's 'silence'.

nodes.title: Copy the Journal
nodes.summary: The librarian wants to make copies of the Warden Journal before something happens to it.

nodes.title: Shulker Shells
nodes.summary: The village builder wants shulker shells for storage that never forgets.

nodes.title: Cold Hearths
nodes.summary: Mara writes that five more beasts stir, and asks you to start in the snow. A snowy village is freezing because its men won't leave the old garrison post. Bring coal and logs and talk to them.
note: Fires lit in the snow village.
Cold village. Warmer now.
They begged for firewood. I sold it.

nodes.title: The Frozen Garrison
nodes.summary: The old garrison still patrols the Yeti Hideout in the snowy plains. Find it, lay the frozen soldiers to rest, kill Skor the Yeti (Bosses' Rise) and read the garrison roll in its barrel.
note: Laid the soldiers to rest. They saluted.
The garrison rests. Skor next.
Frozen soldiers. Easy pickings.

nodes.title: Lost in the Snow
nodes.summary: Skor is dead. Tell the snowy village their grandfathers can rest.
note: Their grandfathers can rest now.
Skor dead. Village told.
No snow today. My doing.

nodes.title: The Buried Well
nodes.summary: A desert village filled in its own well 'so the ground would stop breathing'. Their sick need milk, and the husks need clearing. Then tend the sick.
note: Milk for the sick. The well breathes.
Desert village. Strange well.
Sick villagers pay anything.

nodes.title: The Nest Road
nodes.summary: The husks are being herded toward the Sandworm Nest. Kill the Dune Faithful, find the nest and kill Sirok, the Sandworm.
note: Sirok is dead. The sand is quiet.
Sandworm down. Nest cleared.
A big sandworm. Dead.

nodes.title: The Beast Below
nodes.summary: Sirok is dead. Tell the desert village they can dig their well out.
note: They'll dig their well out. Clean water.
Told them. They can dig.
Their water. Their problem now.

nodes.title: Nets and Knives
nodes.summary: A fishing village won't sail past the black ship anchored offshore. Help them rebuild their dock so they can fish closer to shore.
note: A dock rebuilt. Boats again.
Fixed the dock.
Fixed their dock. Charged by the plank.

nodes.title: The Tidecaller
nodes.summary: Drowned are coming up the beach at night, led by something that calls the tide. Hold the beach.
note: Held the beach. Nobody drowned tonight.
Drowned came. Drowned went.
The tide answers to me now.

nodes.title: The Black Ship
nodes.summary: Board the Kraken Ship in the deep ocean. Kill its crossbowman, rook and captain, and the Kraken, Nerakyss, will rise. Kill it too.
note: The black ship sank. The harbour cheered.
Kraken dead. Ship sunk.
A ship full of treasure. Was.

nodes.title: Terror of the Depths
nodes.summary: Nerakyss is dead. Tell the fishing village the black ship is gone.
note: Forty years of fear, gone.
Told the fishermen. Done.
They can fish. For a fee.

nodes.title: The Soul Guard
nodes.summary: In the Nether's wastes or soul sand valleys stands the Underworld Arena. Clear its soul guard and kill Helvar, the Underworld Knight who holds its gate.
goals: Defeat 3 x soul knight wither skeleton
note: Helvar fought like he wanted to lose.
Underworld Arena cleared.
A knight. A good fight.

nodes.title: Helvar's Oath
nodes.summary: Helvar couldn't speak. He left his oath written down in a barrel in the arena. Read it.
note: 'If I fall, the door will open.' Oh no.
His oath. A door. Which door?
An oath. A door. Open it.

nodes.title: Out of the Underworld
nodes.summary: Leave the Nether. What Helvar wrote is going to follow you.
note: Out of the Underworld. It's following.
Out. Mostly.
Hell was hospitable.

nodes.title: The Last Road
nodes.summary: Mara writes: 'The last one was his once. His mount.' Find the Dragon Tower, fight its skeleton guards, and kill Ashlord, the Infernal Dragon.
goals: Defeat 3 x flaming skeleton guard fireball
note: His mount, once. Sad, somehow.
Ashlord. Last Warden.
A dragon's bones. Priceless.

nodes.title: Dragon Slayer
nodes.summary: Bring Ashlord's bones home to show the smith. (They're given back.)
note: The smith wept at the bones.
Bones shown. Bones returned.
Dragon slayer. Has a ring to it.

nodes.title: Unbound
nodes.summary: All seven Wardens are dead. Tell someone.
note: Seven dead. Why don't I feel safer?
All seven Wardens. Done.
Seven. All mine.

nodes.title: The Watch Needs Eyes
nodes.summary: Halden writes that the Blackwater Cartel is poisoning the valley and paying a third of every emerald to the cult. The Watch can't get close. You can. Meet the Captain of the Watch.
goals: Talk to Captain of the Watch

nodes.title: A Note in the Stash
nodes.summary: Mara writes that the Blackwater Cartel's drug money pays the cult's keepers in the snow, the sand and the sea. The only way to their Don is from inside. Grow a sample of weed (Create: Addictives) and find the Fixer, who is hiring growers.

nodes.title: A Generous Offer
nodes.summary: A letter with a green wax seal: someone wants to meet you on the road. Blackwater has heard you're the kind of hero who can be talked to. Hear the offer. Take it, or refuse it in a way they'll remember.

nodes.title: The Supply Line
nodes.summary: Blackwater moves product through a pillager outpost. Break the runners there and take their manifest.

nodes.title: The Recruiter's Terms
nodes.summary: You said yes. Blackwater wants proof you can grow: sixteen weed (Create: Addictives), handed to the Fixer.

nodes.title: The Bookkeeper
nodes.summary: The manifest leads to Blackwater's bookkeeper: an illager Sorcerer in a dark-forest hut. Take his ledger. With it, the Watch can name every buyer, seller and bribed guard.

nodes.title: Seeds of the Trade
nodes.summary: The Fixer wants a real operation, not a windowsill. Plant a field and fill an order.

nodes.title: Medicine for the Valley
nodes.summary: The ledger lists the villages Blackwater sells to, and the cleric says three people there are already sick from it. Make Narcan (Create: Addictives) and bring it to the cleric before the raid.

nodes.title: First Customers
nodes.summary: A nervous buyer in another village wants rolled product, delivered by hand.

nodes.title: Don Vasco Answers
nodes.summary: Don Vasco, head of Blackwater, waits in the Labyrinth. The Watch wants him alive to stand trial. Some in the valley would rather you didn't bother.

nodes.title: The Hash Market
nodes.summary: Hash moves faster and pays better. Set up your Create machines and fill the Fixer's order.

nodes.title: The Valley Breathes
nodes.summary: Blackwater is broken. Tell the Captain of the Watch.
goals: Talk to Captain of the Watch

nodes.title: A Way Out
nodes.summary: Reeve Halden knows what you've been growing. He also knows you've been doing good lately. He's offering one way out.

nodes.title: Blackwater Wants a Word
nodes.summary: The Blackwater Cartel runs this valley, and Blackwater is run by illagers. They've noticed a new grower.

nodes.title: The Coca Fields
nodes.summary: The Fixer wants to move into white. Plant coca and bring in a harvest.

nodes.title: White Powder Money
nodes.summary: Process the leaves and bring the Fixer his first big order.

nodes.title: A Customer Goes Under
nodes.summary: The nervous buyer's friend comes running: he took too much of what you sold and isn't waking up. Bring Narcan, fast. Afterwards his friend has something to say to you, and what you do about it decides whether you're still in this trade.

nodes.title: Burn It Down
nodes.summary: Getting out starts with the fields. The Watch needs to see them gone, every plant, so nobody can ever say you kept a stash for later. Tear up sixteen of your weed plants (plant more first if you've harvested them), then tell Halden it's done.

nodes.title: Turf War
nodes.summary: Blackwater is done being polite. Their crew is hitting your fields tonight.

nodes.title: Blackwater Sends Its Regards
nodes.summary: Blackwater doesn't let growers retire. Their crew is coming tonight to remind you whose you are. Make sure they never deliver that message to anyone again.

nodes.title: The Sorcerer's Books
nodes.summary: Blackwater's accounts are kept by an illager Sorcerer in a dark-forest hut. Take the books.

nodes.title: Testimony
nodes.summary: Halden can't touch Blackwater without proof. Their books are kept by an illager Sorcerer in a dark-forest hut. Take the ledger and put it in Halden's hands. Your name is in it too. That's the price of getting out.

nodes.title: Crystal
nodes.summary: The Fixer wants the one product Blackwater can't make: crystal. Nobody in the valley makes it purer.

nodes.title: Purity
nodes.summary: Blackwater has a cook of its own: a witch in a swamp hut they call the Chemist, who cuts her crystal with chalk and lye. Buyers are going blind on it, and blaming yours. The Fixer wants her gone, and he wants the valley to know whose product is clean: put her out of business, then bring him a bigger batch than she ever made.

nodes.title: Don Vasco
nodes.summary: Don Vasco, head of Blackwater, waits in the Labyrinth. Make him a partner, or make him an example.

nodes.title: The Big Shipment
nodes.summary: With Blackwater as partners, the first joint shipment goes out. Fill your half.

nodes.title: Remnants
nodes.summary: Blackwater's survivors want revenge for their Don. Finish the war.

nodes.title: King of the Valley
nodes.summary: You run the valley's green trade now. Show the Fixer what you've built.

nodes.title: The Fixer's Price
nodes.summary: The Fixer is gone, and so is half the strongbox. He left a letter: the Watch offered him a clean name for yours, and he took it. He's hiding with hired crossbows at a pillager outpost until the Watch comes to collect him. Get there first. Then decide what a man like that is worth.

nodes.title: Salt in the Wound
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Fallen] Drowned followed your trail to a fishing village and are coming up the shore tonight because of you. Stop them. Then the wrecker who called them is dragged in front of you.

nodes.title: Warm Hands
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Good] The snowy village is still short of fires. Campfires don't go out in the wind. Bring six. Then the harbour asks you to decide what happens to a captured wrecker.

nodes.title: The Fisher's Debt
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Saint] The fishing village lost its boats to the Kraken. Without boats they starve. Bring them four boats. Then the harbour catches the wrecker who lit false lights on the rocks.

nodes.title: Cold Welcome
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Wavering] The snowy village heard about you before you arrived. They won't trade until you prove you're here to help: clear twelve strays stalking their woodcutters. Then a captured wrecker is brought to you.

nodes.title: The Harbour Tax
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Wicked] The fishing village refuses to pay the Hand. Silas wants their iron golem dead as a lesson. Then he wants the wrecker who knows where the Hand's cargo went silenced.

nodes.title: The Last Garrison Man
nodes.summary: One soldier of the frozen garrison is still alive: Brann, half-mad from cold, who led the Yeti's hunters to the village for food. He wants to go home. The snowy village wants him dead.

nodes.title: Snow on the Grave
nodes.summary: You ended Brann in the snow. Someone in the village should know.

nodes.title: Brann Comes Home
nodes.summary: Brann's wife writes. The village didn't hang him. It put him to work rebuilding the walls he helped break.

nodes.title: A Widow's Letter
nodes.summary: Brann's wife learned what happened in the snow. She wants his medal back. You have it.

nodes.title: Please Return the Ship
nodes.summary: Locate the nineteen-years-overdue Patient Gull and settle a maritime debt that has outlived both the vessel and good sense.

nodes.title: The Captain's Share
nodes.summary: Follow the articles of the lost Saint Marrow, settle the crew's dead accounts, and decide who is entitled to the captain's final share.

nodes.title: The Dead's Share
nodes.summary: Captain Vale spared you one final piece of arithmetic: return twelve stolen shares to First Mate Orren.

nodes.title: A Hero's Trophy
nodes.summary: Bring back raider proof from the outpost road and test the village champion's story.

nodes.title: The Last Witness
nodes.summary: Find the outpost witness, hear what happened, then decide whether truth is worth sparing a raider.

nodes.title: Convenient Silence
nodes.summary: The witness is dead, and raiders are cleaning up the outpost road. Stop them before the lie becomes permanent.

nodes.title: The Name Beneath the Medal
nodes.summary: Recover the dead guard's sword, written proof, and village cloth from the outpost road.

nodes.title: The False Hero
nodes.summary: Confront the village champion with the proof of his cowardice and defeat him on the outpost road.

nodes.title: Graves Without Names
nodes.summary: Someone has been burying raiders, strays, and husks outside a desert village. Follow the fresh graves to an old pyramid and find the undertaker responsible.

nodes.title: The Grave He Cannot Fill
nodes.summary: Amar remembers that his body was removed during an old desert plague. Escort him to the ruined portal where the dead were taken and recover the order that condemned him to an unmarked disposal.

nodes.title: Where the Dead Were Sent
nodes.summary: Cross the ruined portal with Amar, follow the plague dead into the Nether, and search a fossil field for the last proof that Amar was ever meant to have a grave.

nodes.title: Not Currently Available
nodes.summary: Amar has one final burial to arrange: his own. Help him mark the death of the man he was, then let him decide whether the grave needs an occupant.

nodes.title: Frost Patrol
nodes.summary: The snowy village wants the strays that drift down from the hideout cleared.

nodes.title: Husk Plague
nodes.summary: The desert village is still overrun with husks from the nest.

nodes.title: Drowned Nets
nodes.summary: The fishing village can't cast a net without drowned climbing up it.

nodes.title: The Pirate Hoard
nodes.summary: The harbourmaster says the black ship's surviving crew are picking over shipwrecks for its lost cargo. Find a shipwreck and stop them.

nodes.title: Soul Lanterns
nodes.summary: Villagers want soul lanterns hung for the dead the Underworld Knight guarded.

nodes.title: Ash Cleanup
nodes.summary: The Dragon Tower's spawners still pour out Ashlord's skeleton guards, and they wander down to burn the farms. Go back to the tower and thin them out.

nodes.title: Blood in the Wells
nodes.summary: Mara says the cult will try to grow its god a new body in blood pits. Before you go, the librarian wants to show you what's been found in the well water. (Reward: a Sickle of Struggle. Hit creatures with it while carrying empty glass bottles and you catch their blood.)
note: Blood in the wells. Children drink there.
Blood in the water.
Blood is a currency too.

nodes.title: The Sinful Church
nodes.summary: The blood comes from a Sinful Church (Sons of Sins). Find it, kill the Devourers born in its blood, and read the recipe the cult is following in a barrel there.
goals: Find and read: The Midwife's Recipe
note: They grew a god in blood. Sick.
Found the church. Read the scripture.
A church of blood. Impressive.

nodes.title: The Midwife
nodes.summary: The woman who runs the blood pits is at the church. Hear her out, then spare her or end her.
note: She counts children. I hope she always will.
The Midwife. Dealt with.
The Midwife. Dealt with. Properly.

nodes.title: The Coven
nodes.summary: The Midwife's sisters come for you a day later. They want blood for blood.
note: Her sisters came. I wish they hadn't.
The coven came for blood.
Blood for blood. They lost.

nodes.title: Cleansing the Pits
nodes.summary: Spared, the Midwife shows you how to sour her blood pits: bury them under soul soil.
note: Buried the pits. Soul soil. Peace.
Pits soured. Job done.
Soured the pits. Kept a sample.

nodes.title: Original Sin
nodes.summary: The pits' failures crawl out at night as Betrayed Guzzlers, bloated things that drink livestock dry. Kill three.
note: Poor things. Born wrong. Put to rest.
Guzzlers dead.
Bloated things. Popped.

nodes.title: Jaws in the Dark
nodes.summary: Villagers who drank from the wells are rising at night as Blood-Born. Hold the village until they stop.
note: They were villagers once. I remember.
Held the village until dawn.
Blood-Born. Not born well.

nodes.title: What Eats the Dead
nodes.summary: To forge armour that can stand in front of a god you'll need Ether Ashes. Creatures killed while standing in blood, by a bone weapon (an Osseous sword or axe), leave ash. The church's blood pools work. Collect eight. (They're given back.)
note: Ether ashes. Armour against a god.
Ashes collected.
Ashes of the dead. Useful dead.

nodes.title: Soul Steel
nodes.summary: Dip iron ingots into blood, or smelt Iron and Ether, to make Soul Steel. Craft a Soul Steel block and place it. Then craft the Remnant (Sinbuster) armour: the next chapter begins the first time its chestplate catches a heavy blow while you carry an Urn of ether ashes.
note: Soul Steel. It hums when I hold it.
Soul Steel block placed.
Forged in blood. Fitting.

nodes.title: Sinbuster
nodes.summary: You wear the Sinbuster now: armour that can 'imprison attacks too brutal for the mortals'. Show the smith.
note: The Sinbuster. Heavy, like guilt.
Armour shown to the smith.
Armour that imprisons attacks. Mine.

nodes.title: The Wrong Parcel
nodes.summary: Mara's courier delivered the wrong bundle. Inside is the page torn from the Warden journal. Ask around about Old Mara.
note: The torn page. M. Mara. Maraal.
Wrong parcel. Right page.
A torn page. Leverage.

nodes.title: Maraal
nodes.summary: She was waiting for you to find the page. Mara is Maraal. Hear her out, then forgive her or reject her.
note: She was waiting for me to find it.
Mara is Maraal. Of course.
She lied. Everybody lies.

nodes.title: Walking with Maraal
nodes.summary: You forgave her. She walks beside you and finally talks about the old days. Rest a night and listen.
note: She talked all night about the old days.
She walks with me now.
She walks with me. Watching.

nodes.title: Alone
nodes.summary: You rejected her. Her letters have stopped. You'll have to learn the Nether the hard way.
note: Her letters stopped. I miss them.
No more letters.
No more letters. Good.

nodes.title: The Crimson Guide
nodes.summary: Ghastlies, the crimson bees of the Nether, know the way to the Nether Mansion. Go below and tame one. The next chapter starts once one follows you.
note: A crimson bee. It hums north.
Tamed a Ghastly.
A bee that leads to gold.

nodes.title: Blood Calls to Blood
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Fallen] The Midwife's sisters can smell old blood on a person, and they smell it on you. Tonight they come. Then a man sick on cult blood finds you: he thinks you'll understand.

nodes.title: Sanctuary
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Good] Families are fleeing the villages near the blood pits. Halden wants a safe house built in Ashford with four beds. Then a man who drank from the blood wells begs for help.

nodes.title: Hands That Heal
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Saint] The blood pits turned villagers into the shambling dead. The cleric can cure them with golden apples if someone brings four. Then a man who drank from the blood wells begs for help.

nodes.title: Amends
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Wavering] Halden sends for you. He wants to see whether you'll pay a debt nobody can make you pay: gold for the families of everyone who died since you came. Then a man sick on cult blood is brought to you.

nodes.title: Blood Money
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Wicked] The Hand has buyers for the cult's blood. Bring Silas four bottles (hit creatures with the Sickle of Struggle while carrying empty bottles), and hear who the Hand really serves. Then he wants a blood addict silenced.
goals: Talk to Silas of the Gilded Hand

nodes.title: Vael's Last Letter
nodes.summary: Brother Vael has been your spy inside the cult since you spared him. This is his last letter. The handwriting shakes.

nodes.title: The Midwife's Daughter
nodes.summary: The Midwife has been healing with the cleric since you sent her there. Her daughter, born in the blood pits, wants to meet the person who gave her mother a second life.
goals: Talk to Wren of the Pits

nodes.title: A Cure for the Common Death
nodes.summary: Doctor Edrin Vale claims he is close to a cheaper cure for zombification. Bring him the first ingredients for his restorative.
nodes.group: A Cure for the Common Death

nodes.title: The Control Group
nodes.summary: Doctor Vale needs one perfectly healthy chicken for what he insists is a rigorous control experiment.
nodes.group: A Cure for the Common Death

nodes.title: The Assistant's Last Notes
nodes.summary: Sera Marr, Doctor Vale's assistant, vanished while collecting samples in an old mineshaft. Find her field notes and learn what happened.
nodes.group: A Cure for the Common Death

nodes.title: Patient Thirteen
nodes.summary: Sera Marr is still alive in the loosest possible sense. Find her, hear what happened, and decide whether she is a patient, a witness, or a threat.
nodes.group: A Cure for the Common Death

nodes.title: The Grand Demonstration
nodes.summary: Doctor Vale is ready to prove his restorative before the entire village. Sera is gone, the apparatus is full, and the bell square has become his laboratory.
nodes.group: A Cure for the Common Death

nodes.title: The Grand Demonstration
nodes.summary: Doctor Vale proceeds with his public experiment despite Sera's warning. She promised to dilute the serum before he begins. You are about to learn whether she succeeded.
nodes.group: A Cure for the Common Death

nodes.title: Instructions for My Own Funeral
nodes.summary: Carry out Garrick Bell's extremely specific funeral instructions and discover why he was so insistent about the time of burial.

nodes.title: Instructions for My Second Funeral
nodes.summary: Garrick's correction is very clear: return to the grave, use the bell, and this time speak to him before killing him.

nodes.title: Instructions for My Third Funeral
nodes.summary: Garrick's third volume contains an unexpected correction: the next funeral belongs to Corwin, whose attempt to improve the family ritual has gone badly.

nodes.title: The Man Who Buried Himself
nodes.summary: Follow Calder Venn's final journal to the mineshaft where he sealed himself away from something that knew his footsteps, his tools, and perhaps his face.

nodes.title: The Man Who Came Back Warm
nodes.summary: Follow Edric Hale's account of a journey through a ruined portal and discover what finally came back wearing his name.
nodes.group: The Man Who Came Back Warm

nodes.title: The Blood Tithe
nodes.summary: The cleric wants to study the cult's blood so she can cleanse the wells.

nodes.title: The Midwife's Debt
nodes.summary: The Midwife you spared sends word: she wants to undo what she poured. She needs ash.

nodes.title: Guzzler Hunt
nodes.summary: Betrayed Guzzlers, bloated things the Sins left behind, crawl out at night and drink the livestock dry. Hunt them down.

nodes.title: Crimson Honey
nodes.summary: The cleric wants Ghastly honey. She thinks it might heal the cursed.

nodes.title: Follow the Crimson Bee
nodes.summary: Your Ghastly hums north. Follow it to the Nether Mansion, the Cult of Azazel's Sacred City, and talk to the Welcomer who greets every pilgrim at its gate.
note: The Sacred City. Gold and chains.
The Mansion. The Welcomer bowed.
A city of gold. Finally.

nodes.title: The Cursed Quarries
nodes.summary: Ashford's men are mining gold for a god in the Mansion's quarries. Kill the Manipulators who drive them.
note: Tomas is free. Halden will cry.
Quarries cleared. Prisoners freed.
Freed the miners. Kept the gold.

nodes.title: Hold the Quarry Gate
nodes.summary: The freed prisoners need time to reach your portal. Hold the quarry gate against the piglin wardens.
note: Every prisoner through the portal.
Gate held.
Held the gate. They owe me.

nodes.title: Gilded Hunger
nodes.summary: In the Sacred City, Gilded Golems drink gold and blood. Kill three, then talk to the Doctor who was watching. He and the Blacksmith will trade with you.
note: Golems that drink blood. Not any more.
Three golems down.
Golems of gold. Melted down.

nodes.title: Do Not Provoke Gehinnom
nodes.summary: The cult's guidebook says 'best not to provoke' the Gehinnom guardians. You have to, to reach the Lair.
note: Provoked them. Had to.
Gehinnom provoked.
Best not to provoke? Ha.

nodes.title: The Instruction
nodes.summary: Reach Azazel's Lair at the end of the Mansion. A barrel there holds the instructions to summon him.
note: 'Hand over your weapon.' I won't.
The instruction. Read it.
How to summon a god. Mine now.

nodes.title: Hand Over Your Weapon
nodes.summary: Fight the Divine Chariot Azazel in his Lair. If you hand him a sword or axe he lets you live and you'll have to come back. Kill him and take his Staff of Manipulation.
note: I killed half a god. Half.
Azazel's down. Half of him.
Half a god at my feet.

nodes.title: Half a Soul Cannot Die
nodes.summary: A letter arrives the moment you're home. Read it to someone.
note: A half-soul cannot die. Then what?
Read the letter. Head on body.
Make him whole. Then see.

nodes.title: Ash and Ember
nodes.summary: The Siege: The Watch locked the gate on you. You fight outside the walls, alone. Then: [Reputation: Fallen] Before the end, the cleric wants a word. She has watched you make mistakes and pay for them. Then the freed men drag the neighbour who sold them in front of you.

nodes.title: The Freed Remember
nodes.summary: The Siege: Half the Watch came. The other half is guarding the children. Hold. Then: [Reputation: Good] The men you freed from the quarries are walking home. One is too weak to make it alone. Walk him the last stretch. Then the freed men bring you the neighbour who sold them.

nodes.title: The Lantern's End
nodes.summary: The Siege: The whole Watch stands on the wall with you. Hold until the Hand breaks. Then: [Reputation: Saint] Halden has something for you before the end: the Lantern of Ashford, carried by the Watch for a hundred years. Then the freed men bring you the neighbour who sold them.

nodes.title: The Freed Don't Thank You
nodes.summary: The Siege: Nobody's sure whose side you're on. Only Halden stands with you. Hold anyway. Then: [Reputation: Wavering] The men freed from the quarries have heard stories about you. Halden's son wants to look you in the eye before he decides what you are. Then the freed men bring you the neighbour who sold them.

nodes.title: Golden Chains
nodes.summary: The Siege: The siege isn't the Hand's. It's Ashford's. They've set their golems on you. Then: [Reputation: Wicked] The quarries are broken but their gold is still lying there. Carry four blocks out for Silas, and hear his last advice. Then he wants the neighbour who knows his name silenced.
goals: Talk to Silas of the Gilded Hand

nodes.title: Tomas at the Gate
nodes.summary: You sent Halden's son home instead of taking him into the Mansion. Halden has written to you about it.

nodes.title: Free Men Remember
nodes.summary: A letter from one of the men you freed from the Cursed Quarries. He's home in Ashford, and he'd like to see you.

nodes.title: Among the Dead
nodes.summary: A worried villager asks you to check on a friend who went deep underground to study zombies by pretending to be one of them.

nodes.title: The Ash Merchant
nodes.summary: Follow the account book of Silas Dorn into the Nether and learn what the prices beside those human names really meant.

nodes.title: Pay the Freed
nodes.summary: The men freed from the Quarries mined gold for a god. They should be paid for it.

nodes.title: Caution
nodes.summary: The guidebook's trail: 'Pipes. Compass. Pillar. Head. Puzzle. Maze. Caution. Up. God?' Find the maze.
note: Pipes, compass, pillar... maze. Careful.
Found the maze.
Caution. For others.

nodes.title: Up
nodes.summary: Above the maze waits the head altar, with 'God?' carved into the stone. Find it.
note: 'God?' carved in stone. I wonder too.
The altar. 'God?'
'God?' Yes. Soon.

nodes.title: The Choir of the Whole God
nodes.summary: Everything the cult has left comes to the altar, to stop the reunion or to watch it. Kill them all.
note: The cult's last choir. Silent now.
Choir dead. Altar clear.
They sang their last hymn for me.

nodes.title: Bow at My Feet
nodes.summary: 'Approach, beast, and bow at my feet.' This quest only completes if you accept his mercy and take his Cult Scroll. If you kill him instead, ignore it: his barrel holds a letter for you.
note: I bowed. I'm not sure why.
I knelt. He let me live.
I bowed. Best deal going.

nodes.title: Maraal's Last Letter
nodes.summary: He died whole. His last words, in the Old Tongue: 'Maraal, it's my fault...' Go home. Tell them.
note: He died whole. 'Maraal, it's my fault.'
He died whole. Strange last words.
He died whole. Pity.

nodes.title: Tithe of Gold
nodes.summary: Gold is faith made solid. Bring the first tithe.
note: Gold as faith. I gave it anyway.
The first tithe. Paid.
The first tithe. Many more.

nodes.title: Ashford Rebuilt
nodes.summary: Halden's son wants to rebuild the hall his father lost. Help him finish it.
note: Ashford's hall stands. Tomas built it.
Helped Tomas finish the hall.
Ashford rebuilt. On my terms.

nodes.title: The Last Preacher
nodes.summary: He is whole now, so she can finally die. His first command: find Maraal.
note: Find Maraal. I don't want to.
His first command. Find Maraal.
Find Maraal. Gladly.

nodes.title: What Remains
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Fallen] The god is dead or crowned, and you are the one who decided. This is who the valley thinks you are. Go and hear it.

nodes.title: Ashford's Friend
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Good] The god is dead or crowned, and you are the one who decided. This is who the valley thinks you are. Go and hear it.

nodes.title: The Lantern-Bearer
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Saint] The god is dead or crowned, and you are the one who decided. This is who the valley thinks you are. Go and hear it.

nodes.title: The Scales
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Wavering] The god is dead or crowned, and you are the one who decided. This is who the valley thinks you are. Go and hear it.

nodes.title: The Gilded Throne
nodes.summary: [Reputation: Wicked] The god is dead or crowned, and you are the one who decided. This is who the valley thinks you are. Go and hear it.
goals: Talk to Silas of the Gilded Hand

nodes.title: The Last Raid on Ashford
nodes.summary: The cult's last raiders want to burn Ashford before the end. Hold it one more time.

nodes.title: Whispers of a New God
nodes.summary: The god is dead, but his Sacred City is not empty. Halden has heard that someone is sitting on Azazel's throne and calling himself the Gilded One.
note: Someone on the throne. Of course.
A new god? Already?
An empty throne. Tempting.

nodes.title: The Pretender
nodes.summary: Return to the Nether Mansion. Silas sits on the throne surrounded by gold-wardens. End his reign.
note: Silas on a throne. Not for long.
Silas. Pretender. Ended.
Silas got greedy. I got there first.

nodes.title: The First Command
nodes.summary: Azazel is whole and you are his Hand. His first command: the beacon you lit over the village must go dark. It offends him.
note: Darken the beacon? My beacon?
His first command. The beacon.
Darken the beacon. Gladly.

nodes.title: The Last Faithful
nodes.summary: The last of the Faithful kneel in front of the empty throne. Their leader asks you what they're supposed to do now.
note: They asked me what to do. Go home.
The Faithful asked. I answered.
The last Faithful. Last indeed.

nodes.title: Ashford Must Kneel
nodes.summary: Ashford refuses to tithe. Azazel wants their golems broken so they understand there is nothing left to protect them.
note: I broke Ashford's golems. I'm sorry.
Ashford knelt.
Ashford kneels. As it should.

nodes.title: Morning
nodes.summary: The throne is empty for good. Go home. Ring the bell.
note: Rang the bell. It rang.
Morning. Finally.
Morning. Mine.

nodes.title: Halden's Last Stand
nodes.summary: Reeve Halden has come to stop you, alone, with his father's spear. He doesn't expect to win.
note: Halden came alone. Brave old man.
Halden's last stand.
Halden came alone. Foolish old man.

nodes.title: The Hand of Azazel
nodes.summary: The roads are yours. Bring your god his tithe, and take your place at his right hand.
note: His right hand. What have I become?
The Hand of Azazel. That's me now.
The roads are mine. All of them.

nodes.title: The Lantern Road
nodes.summary: Word of what you are has spread. The villages along the old road want to light it end to end, the way it was before the cult, and they want you to carry the first flame. Place twenty lanterns along the road out of your village.

nodes.title: Silas Makes an Offer
nodes.summary: Your name frightens people now, and Silas of the Gilded Hand has noticed. He wants to make you a partner. Meet him, hear him out, and take his first job: break a village's iron golem so it learns who protects it now.
goals: Talk to Silas of the Gilded Hand

nodes.title: A Letter from Silas
nodes.summary: Silas of the Gilded Hand has written to you. He finds you suspicious.

nodes.title: What the God Saw
nodes.summary: You dreamt the fall in full, and it doesn't match what anyone teaches. The hymn says the Sun Spirit threw him out of the sky. In your dream, he jumped. The Sun Spirit's hall might still show it.

nodes.title: The Last Pilgrim
nodes.summary: The pilgrim you fed knew your name. He is Oren, and long ago he taught a boy called Vael to count, before the cult taught Vael what to count. He asks one thing: light a candle where Vael kept his ledgers.

nodes.title: Sky and Fire
nodes.summary: You carried something from the Aether into the Nether, and the Nether went quiet around you. Something down here recognises it. The silence leads toward a bastion.

nodes.title: A Voice Under the Gold
nodes.summary: The third shrine answered you. Not in any language you know: in the Old Tongue, the cult's own. One word, over and over. Write it down before it goes.

nodes.title: Clean Hands
nodes.summary: Silas's man has been going through your things. He's somewhere near, in the Gilded Hand's colours. Catch him. What you do with him is up to you, and Silas is watching.

nodes.title: Why a God Would Jump
