nodes.summary: Why would anyone leap out of the sky? Tell someone what you saw, and see if it sounds as true out loud.

nodes.title: What Oren Left
nodes.summary: Oren was gone by morning. He left his bowl at your door and a note: 'Thank you. Whatever he became, he was a good boy once. Fill this for whoever walks the road next.'

nodes.title: The War of Halves
nodes.summary: The painting told a war: the sky against the fire, a god against himself. Show the gilded stone to someone old enough to know the stories.

nodes.title: The Name Before
nodes.summary: The word is a name: the Chariot's name, from before the cult gave him another. A Believer's House would have it written somewhere, under the prayers. Find it, and find out why nobody says it.

nodes.title: Lost Page 1: The Calling
nodes.summary: A loose page from the Warden Journal, written by Mara's first champion. It mentions a place. Go and see it.

nodes.title: Lost Page 2: The Wardens
nodes.summary: A loose page from the Warden Journal, written by Mara's first champion. It mentions a place. Go and see it.

nodes.title: Lost Page 3: Her Name
nodes.summary: A loose page from the Warden Journal, written by Mara's first champion. It mentions a place. Go and see it.

nodes.title: Lost Page 4: The Price
nodes.summary: A loose page from the Warden Journal, written by Mara's first champion. It mentions a place. Go and see it.

nodes.title: Lost Page 5: The Sea
nodes.summary: A loose page from the Warden Journal, written by Mara's first champion. It mentions a place. Go and see it.

nodes.title: Lost Page 6: The Cold
nodes.summary: A loose page from the Warden Journal, written by Mara's first champion. It mentions a place. Go and see it.

nodes.title: Lost Page 7: The Fall
nodes.summary: A loose page from the Warden Journal, written by Mara's first champion. It mentions a place. Go and see it.

nodes.title: Lost Page 8: The Grave
nodes.summary: A loose page from the Warden Journal, written by Mara's first champion. It mentions a place. Go and see it.

nodes.title: The First Champion
nodes.summary: All eight pages found. The first champion asked to be buried 'where the old stones are, where the road used to be'. Find the trail ruins and pay your respects to the one who walked this road before you.

nodes.title: The Woman Who Watches the Moon
nodes.summary: An observatory on the peak, a brass telescope pointed at the sky, and a woman who hasn't looked away from it in thirty years.

nodes.title: A Metal for the Sky
nodes.summary: Hester says nothing made of iron will survive the climb. Titanium will: it's in these mountains, high up on the peaks or deep under them. Smelt some and bring her eight ingots to prove the hills have enough for a rocket.

nodes.title: Fire Under Glass
nodes.summary: Before anyone sits on top of a fire, Hester wants to see one. Build a Rocket Thruster (Create: Cosmonautics) and set it down on solid ground. It drinks lava. Keep your eyebrows away from the business end.

nodes.title: A Little Moon of Our Own
nodes.summary: Hester's dream: a Sputnik Probe, a little metal moon of our own, going round the world and looking down. Build one. Then build something that can carry it up, and carry it up.

nodes.title: Above the Sky
nodes.summary: You made it. The world is a ball under you, blue and green and very small. Set the probe free up here.

nodes.title: What the Probe Saw
nodes.summary: Hester has been at the receiver since the probe went up. She's seen him now. Go and hear it, then get ready to go: a Space Helmet, and a Jetpack to keep air in it.

nodes.title: The Silver Sea
nodes.summary: Grey dust, black sky, the world hanging over you like a lantern. Somewhere near, the Faithful's wreck. Find it, and find out what they came for.
goals: Find and read: The Ascension's Log

nodes.title: The Man in the Moon
nodes.summary: Iskar, the Silver King, lies across the great crater with his sword in his hand. The Faithful who didn't die are still there, chipping at him. They don't breathe any more. They don't need to.

nodes.title: Come Home Alive
nodes.summary: The Eclipse is cold in your hand, and heavier than it looks. It only answers to the living: die anywhere before your feet touch the overworld again and it goes home to his hand. Hester made you promise. Fuel for the way home.

nodes.title: Rest
nodes.summary: You put the Eclipse back in his hand and left him to the dust. Tell Hester what you found, and what you did.

nodes.title: The Silver King's Blade
nodes.summary: You're home, and alive, and the Eclipse is yours. Hester will want to see it. She'll want to see you, mostly.
